before: While a drawing was selected, text pasted on a selected text box or shape went in before the drawing's anchor run, and inserting a picture was refused.
after: Text pasted on a selected text box replaces the text box story. A picture inserted while editing and other pastes go in before the anchor run. A shape with no text body, a linked text box, and pasted content with a picture on a text box refuse with a reason.
reason: The paste enters the text box story and replaces its text with the released insert, split, and range-deletion operations or the released fragment-paste path, and the picture uses the released insert-drawing operation. No released operation adds a text body to an existing shape, so that paste refuses instead of adding a new operation. Shared nodes, offsets, operations, and the collaboration format stay unchanged.
